name: terrace-desert
description: Terrace, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10c): the shipped Terrace drawn again as a windcatcher row: sandstone and mud-brick houses between proud pilasters, a lattice rawshan over every door, flat roofs behind a coping and a slotted windcatcher over every household.
